method: Fusion design.analyzeInterference (moving bodies + all static bodies whose bbox is within 3 mm), servo -45..+45 in 5 deg steps plus +-44.99; surface/pushrod poses driven from kinematics.json via the joints (render_animations_fusion.py). Sliders and wheels: temp-BRep boolean intersections of every mover body with every static body (bbox prefiltered). Props: swept-disc annulus (blade radius + margin) interference. Code: fusion/motion_clearance_fusion.py (run inside Fusion).
exempt_contacts: arm Z-bend in arm hole (rod 1.83 mm in the arm hole, 7.89 mm3, constant over the sweep)
LiPo straps HW-108 (flexible webbing around the battery)
clevis pin in horn hole (coincident faces)
servo arm on the servo output spline

collisions_before.pair: Aileron skin vs Wing_Panel (TE-down, lower edges close the 4.77 mm gap)
Pushrod rod (HW-084) vs Wing_Panel pocket wall (TE-up)

fixes: Cove cut in each Wing_Panel TE = union of the aileron LE strip (3.1 cm deep) rotated 0..28.5 deg (throw+2.4) in 1.5 deg steps, offset 0.8 mm in the section plane and 0.8 mm in span (Wing_Panel_R/L -24.4 cm3 each incl. a first 1 deg pass)
Pushrod exit slots: union of rod+bead (and clevis) over servo -45..+45, offset 1.5-2.0 mm, cut from Wing_Panel_R/L (-0.5 cm3 +0.12 cm3 per side)
Servo-arm relief in the wing bay: swept arm (20 poses) offset 1.0 mm cut from Wing_Panel (13 mm3 per side)

collisions_before.pair: Elevator vs HW-058 tail saddle R/L
Elevator vs HW-131 rudder servo case R/L

fixes: Inverse-swept relief cut from the Elevator skin: Fin, Boom_Rear_Stub, tail saddle HW-058 and rudder servo HW-131 offset 1.0 mm and rotated -26.25..+27 deg about the hinge (Elevator -0.58 cm3 total, 1.6 percent of its volume, at the two end corners)

collisions_before.pair: Rudder skin vs HW-058 tail saddle
Rudder horn HW-093 and backing plate HW-094 vs HW-058 tail saddle
Horn HW-093 vs Kwik-Link clevis HW-097 and rod HW-098 (rudder R at servo <= -30, L at >= +30)

fixes: Saddle HW-058_3 (R) and HW-058_4 (L) cut by the swept rudder skin + horn + plate (+-25 deg, offset 1.0 mm): -363 mm3 each (2 percent of the part)
Horn HW-093 relief cut by the clevis+rod swept in the rudder frame (offset 0.5 mm, pin zone r<1.5 mm excluded): -23 mm3 each

min_clearance_mm.clevis/rod to horn: >=0.5 by construction (pin in hole is the intended contact)

lift_props_L1..L4.sweep: annulus r 32..216 mm about each motor axis, z 22..39 mm, spun 0..360 (envelope)

pusher.sweep: annulus r 30..178 mm about the Y axis

wheels.sweep: 0, 36, 72 deg (spoke pitch 72) vs legs, collars, blocks, gear clamps

collisions_before: Panel R chain drags H_Tail/Elevator/Hinge_Elevator (joint tree), H-tail must be removed first
sliders.note: With the H-tail removed the panel (booms, clamps, motors, props, gear, ESCs all ride with it) slides off the joiner with no collision; the only overlap is the root hard-point plate at 0 mm (intended screw contact, 33 mm3).
overlaps are the hinge tape embedded in the fins only (flexible)
at 0 the 4 heat-set inserts sit in the pod bores (intended) and a cable tie touches the canopy 0.6 mm3; clear from 20 mm up

collisions_before.pair: Battery vs Fuselage_Pod pocket (zero play, 7200 mm3 per 3 mm)
Battery vs pod formers HW-104 (rings 4 mm, 6.5 mm behind and 9.5 mm in front of the battery)
Battery vs cable ties HW-140 / J-28 ties, XT90S

fixes: Pod pocket extended -5/+8 mm with the swept battery (Fuselage_Pod -31.2 cm3)
Slider limit reduced to -4/+7 mm (formers stop it); kinematics.json, make_kinematics.py, joints_spec.json and the Fusion joint updated
sliders.open_issue: The battery cannot be lifted out in this CAD: pod solid above it (z>-2.0 to 5), Wing_Saddle spans y -23.9..0 over its rear 17 mm and the canopy only covers y 10..31. Needs a hatch or a pod redesign (not done).

breakdown_order: 2 (battery stays; no removal path in CAD)
4 both wing panels outboard 300 mm off the joiner (booms, motors, props, gear, fins and servos ride with them)
final_verification: Full 19-step sweep (-44.99..+44.99 every 5 deg) of all five mechanisms run after the fixes: 0 rigid collisions (only the constant 7.89 mm3 Z-bend in the arm hole); wheels, props, sliders re-checked.
caveat: Offsets were made with a 10-14 direction shift union, not a true offset, so clearances are approximate (sliver intersections < 0.5 mm3 remain at the tested offsets). Fusion measureMinimumDistance returned 0 for several pairs that are 2 mm apart (point-on-surface artifacts), so it was not used.
